d: What does healthy aging look like? How do you know if you’re aging well? Mariana is almost 60 and can still pull herself up with just three fingers. Melinda is 61 and has never touched a weight. Both faced 7 science-backed fitness tests, including the sit to stand test, alongside younger participants — each worth 1 point for baseline, 2 for advanced — to find out what age and lifestyle really do to the body. We’ll also learn how to optimize your performance on these tests for longevity’s sake.
